:::{#def-monomial}
#### Monomial (power product)

A **monomial**, also called a **power product**
[@wikipedia_monomial],
in the variables $x_1, \ldots, x_p$
is an [expression](expressions-algorithms.qmd#def-expression)

$$
x_1^{a_1} x_2^{a_2} \cdots x_p^{a_p}
$$ {#eq-monomial}

that multiplies [powers](algebra-basics.qmd#def-power) of those variables,
whose [exponents](algebra-basics.qmd#def-power-exponent) $a_1, \ldots, a_p$
are nonnegative [integers](number-systems.qmd#def-integers).

Each $a_j = 0$ contributes the factor $x_j^0 = 1$
([zero exponent](algebra-basics.qmd#def-power-integer)).

:::
